rows.grounds: compound of caturtha and pāda with enclitic ca
fused form of śrīvidyā iti śeṣaḥ

items.question: What remains to be identified as Śrīvidyā once the fourth foot is seen?
items.inference: The seen fourth foot leaves a remainder identified as Śrīvidyā.
uncertainties: Exact syntactic role of iti within the fused token.
items.plain_english: And the fourth foot is seen; that is the remainder called Śrīvidyā.
